brands.note: Which brand mark a row shows. Every id names a vendored lockup in packages/assets/src/icons/combine/; scripts/build.mjs fails the build on an id that is not there. This is presentation data, kept out of the bundle like the rest of this document, and it is separate from the copy rules above: a vendor's mark and a vendor's description line change for different reasons. `providers` is deliberately empty: a model no rule claims draws **no** lockup rather than its provider's, because the reseller's own lockup on a model it did not make reads as a wrong answer rather than a missing one. `models` is an ordered, anchored rule list resolved against the model's id and then its display name (D79), exactly like `families` and with the same discipline: first match wins, so a broad rule must sit below the narrow ones and every rule must name its vendor (`step` cannot match `step-3.7-flash` by accident only if no earlier rule already claimed it). A brand with no lockup renders the label without a mark.

models.note: Claude rows draw Claude's own lockup, not the parent Anthropic one: the label names the model line, and a wordmark has to match the word it stands in for — the same reason Grok rows draw Grok's rather than xAI's. Anthropic stays the fallback for the `anthropic` route.
Nano Banana is a Gemini image model with its own identity in the catalog, so it draws its own lockup rather than the Gemini one.
Gemma is Google's open model line, so it draws its own lockup rather than the parent Google one — the same reason Claude and Grok do.
A Gemini row shows the model line's mark; the provider group header above it shows Google's, because providers resolve from `providers` and never from here.

The id can carry the serving provider's namespace (`cn:k3`, `moonshot/k3`), so the segment start accepts any character outside a letter or a digit. Requiring `k3` to start a segment is what leaves `mk3` unclaimed.

The id can carry the serving provider's namespace (`cn:m3`), so the segment start accepts any character outside a letter or a digit. Requiring `m2` or `m3` to start a segment is what leaves `pm2` unclaimed.
Grok is the model line, xAI the company: a Grok row shows Grok's own mark, while the provider group header above it still shows xAI's, because providers resolve from `providers` and never from here.

The id can carry the serving provider's namespace (`cn:hy3`, `openrouter/hy3`), so the segment start accepts any character outside a letter or a digit. Requiring `hy` to start a segment is what leaves `shy-mt2` unclaimed.
The vendor name has to start a segment and end one: unanchored, this rule claims `sensenova-6.8-flash-lite` for Amazon and lands that lockup in the middle of the name.

Beam is Reflection's own line, so its rows draw the vendor's lockup — whose word is the vendor's, and the catalog's own name never spells it (`Beam Free · OpenCode Go`), so the label leads with the lockup instead of replacing a word in it.

lockups.note: Per-brand overrides for the vendored lockup, applied by scripts/fetch-lobe-combines.py. `word` is the word the lockup stands in for inside a model name (it must match how the catalog spells it, which is not always Lobe's TITLE), `mark` and `text` name the Lobe icons the two halves are taken from (so a model line can wear its own mark with its parent's wordmark), `keep` crops a wordmark to a fraction of its ink width (GLM-V's "-V" is not part of the name), and `tint` is the brand colour a hand-provided mark wears on the ivory canvas, where a fetched mark carries Lobe's own.

text.zh: 非对称模型结构，小成本大智能。

families.note: Every DeepSeek Flash reads the same line: the copy describes the line, not a version, so a retired Flash and a future one say the same thing. Anchored on `deepseek` on purpose: an unanchored /flash$/ would hand this copy to glm-5.3-flash, step-3.7-flash and every other vendor's flash tier.
The Pro line's own official heading on the V4 preview page. No rule pins it to a version: a Pro is a Pro whatever its version.

text.zh: 性能比肩顶级闭源模型。
text.en: Performance rivaling the world's top closed-source models.

families.note: Everything else in the line — V3.2, R1, and whatever comes next — shares the V4.1 release title.

text.zh: 更强、更快、更普惠。
text.en: Smarter, faster, more affordable.

families.note: Fable is a model line of its own (Mythos / Fable / Opus / Sonnet / Haiku), so it must not fall through to the generic Claude rule. Its copy is the line tagline from anthropic.com/claude/fable, and it carries no tier prefix of ours.

text.zh: 新一代智能，专为解决最艰深的知识工作和编程难题。
text.en: Next generation of intelligence for the hardest knowledge work and coding problems.

families.note: Mythos is Fable's unrestricted sibling — Anthropic's own words: Fable is the same underlying model with cybersecurity and biology safeguards added. Access to Mythos is limited to vetted organizations, so its copy leads with the audience rather than the capability.

text.zh: 面向网络安全与生物学研究的可靠模型。
text.en: Built for cybersecurity and biology research, with access limited to vetted organizations.

families.note: Family copy stays version-agnostic, so it carries no superlatives: 'strongest' is only true of the current generation and would mislabel an older Opus. Superlatives belong in a rule anchored to the version. It also carries no tier prefix of ours — '旗舰档：' is our positioning, not the model's own line.

text.zh: 面向速度敏感的高吞吐场景，响应快、成本低。

text.zh: Anthropic Claude 模型。

text.zh: 为 Codex 智能体编程优化，可并行处理多项软件工程任务。
text.en: Optimized for agentic coding in Codex, handling several software tasks in parallel.

families.note: Anchored to the 5.4 generation: the context size and the computer use are that model's, so a later GPT-5 reads the rule below.

text.zh: 面向编程与专业工作的长上下文模型。

text.zh: OpenAI 开发的开放权重推理模型。

text.zh: 支持文本与图像输入、多语言。

text.zh: 面向复杂任务、深度推理与多模态理解。

text.zh: 原生理解文本、图像、视频与音频。
text.en: Native text, image, video and audio understanding.

families.note: Gemma is Google's open line, not a Gemini tier, so it must not inherit the Gemini rule's copy. Its place below the generic Gemini rule is only for readability: the two patterns cannot overlap.

text.zh: 面向编程与知识工作的 2.8T 开放权重模型。

text.zh: 能力与成本均衡，完整工具调用支持。

families.note: MoE ids spell out total and active parameters (`2.4t-a95b`, `235b-a22b`); the active count must win over the size rule below, which would otherwise read the trailing `95b` as a small dense model.

families.note: Anchored to a separator so the digits start a segment: an unanchored \d+b matches the `95b` inside `a95b` and calls a 2.4T MoE a small dense model.

text.zh: 覆盖文本推理、多模态与语音，经官方开放平台提供。
